predecessors.name: Archbishopric of Riga
predecessors.text: the city of Riga (the municipality of Riga stands for the city and its immediate land)

successors.name: Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth
successors.text: the city of Riga (the municipality of Riga stands for the city and its immediate land)

ledger.x: 1561: the archbishop's rule over Riga ends.
1581: Riga comes under the Polish-Lithuanian crown.
1581: the twenty years of free imperial status end with the Treaty of Drohiczyn.

wars.name: Livonian War
wars.outcome: The war for Riga ended with the Treaty of Drohiczyn in 1581, which reduced Riga's privileges; Riga then came under Polish-Lithuanian rule.

certainty.note: A walled city: the Riga municipality is the best draw, the page names no outlying land.
